tools.name: get_client_state
tools.title: Get client state
tools.description: Reports whether the game client is logged in, the current zone/territory, map, instance, language, whether PvP or GPose is active, and which condition flags are currently set. Call this first: most other tools report nothing useful while logged out.

tools.name: get_local_player
tools.title: Get local player
tools.description: Detailed information about the player character you control: identity, world, job, level, HP/MP, position, and current statuses. Returns loggedIn=false when no character is loaded.

tools.name: get_player_attributes
tools.title: Get player attributes
tools.description: Character sheet attributes (Strength, Dexterity, Vitality, Intelligence, Mind, Piety, crafting/gathering stats, resistances, and more) from PlayerState. The attributes object contains current panel values including equipment; the six top-level primary stats are base values without equipment.

tools.name: get_job_levels
tools.title: Get job levels
tools.description: Level and experience for every class and job, plus which ones are unlocked. Use 'job'abbr to see the abbreviation (e.g. WHM, DRK).

tools.name: get_conditions
tools.title: Get conditions
tools.description: Lists every ConditionFlag that is currently true (in combat, mounted, crafting, in a duty, etc.). Useful before asking the agent to do anything that requires a specific state.

tools.name: get_currency
tools.title: Get currency
tools.description: Current gil, tomestones, company seals, allied seals, wolf marks, gold saucer coins, and other tracked currencies, with their names.

tools.name: get_titles_and_achievements
tools.title: Get titles and achievements
tools.description: Unlocked titles and achievement progress. Provide 'titleId' or 'achievementId' to inspect a single entry, otherwise a summary is returned.

titleId.description: Optional: inspect one title by id

achievementId.description: Optional: inspect one achievement by id

tools.name: get_unlock_state
tools.title: Get unlock state
tools.description: Checks whether a specific game thing is unlocked: mounts, minions, emotes, orchestrion rolls, triple triad cards, recipes, instances, actions, and more.

id.description: The row id to check (or the unlock link value for 'unlockLink')

type.description: What kind of thing to check

tools.name: get_aetherytes
tools.title: Get aetherytes
tools.description: Aetherytes available to teleport to, with gil cost, territory, and whether they are favourited. Only populated while logged in.

tools.name: get_game_objects
tools.title: Get game objects
tools.description: Lists objects the game has loaded around you (players, NPCs, enemies, minions, mounts, treasure chests, aetherytes, ...). Filter by objectKind, name substring, or maximum distance. Set detailed=false for a compact listing.

objectKind.description: Filter to one ObjectKind, e.g. Pc, BattleNpc, EventNpc, Treasure

nameContains.description: Only include objects whose name contains this text (case-insensitive)

maxDistance.description: Only include objects within this many yalms of the local player

detailed.description: Include HP, level, job, casting and statuses (default true)

tools.name: find_game_object
tools.title: Find game object
tools.description: Looks up a single object by entityId, gameObjectId, or exact name. Returns the best match plus any alternatives that share the name.

gameObjectId.description: Game object id to look up

name.description: Exact (case-insensitive) object name to look up

tools.name: get_party
tools.title: Get party
tools.description: The current party or alliance: members, their jobs, levels, HP/MP, world, territory, and statuses. Also reports which member is the party leader.

tools.name: get_targets
tools.title: Get targets
tools.description: Your current hard target, focus target, soft target, mouseover target, and previous target.

tools.name: get_fates
tools.title: Get FATEs
tools.description: Active FATEs in the current zone with level range, progress, time remaining, and position. Pass fateId to inspect a single FATE.

fateId.description: Optional: inspect one FATE by id

tools.name: get_nearby_enemies
tools.title: Get nearby enemies
tools.description: Battle NPCs within a radius, sorted by distance, with HP percentages and statuses. Convenience wrapper over get_game_objects for combat planning.

tools.name: get_object_table_info
tools.title: Get object table info
tools.description: Raw addresses and counts of the object table, plus the entry count per client object array. Use with read_memory to inspect unmanaged structures.

tools.name: search_game_data
tools.title: Search game data
tools.description: Searches a game data sheet (Excel) by text. Example sheets: Item, Action, Status, Quest, Mount, Companion, Emote, Recipe, CraftAction, Trait, TerritoryType, World, ClassJob, InstanceContent, ContentFinderCondition, ENpcResident, BNpcName, PlaceName, Aetheryte. Use list_game_data_sheets to discover names and get_game_data_sheet_info to see which columns are searchable.

query.description: Text to look for in the sheet's text columns

exact.description: Require an exact (case-insensitive) match instead of a substring (default false)

tools.name: get_game_data_row
tools.title: Get game data row
tools.description: Reads one row from a game data sheet by its row id, returning every readable column. Row references to other sheets are returned as {"rowId": n} rather than expanded.

tools.name: list_game_data_sheets
tools.title: List game data sheets
tools.description: Lists Excel sheet names available to the plugin, optionally filtered by a substring. There are over a thousand sheets, so pass a filter when you know roughly what you want.

filter.description: Only return sheets whose name contains this text

tools.name: get_game_data_sheet_info
tools.title: Get game data sheet info
tools.description: Describes a sheet: row count, column count, and the searchable text columns. Use this before search_game_data to learn which fields carry readable text.

tools.name: get_item
tools.title: Get item
tools.description: Looks up an item by id or by name and returns its common fields: name, description, item level, equip level, rarity, category, stack size, and vendor price.

name.description: Item name (case-insensitive exact match, or substring if contains=true)

contains.description: Treat 'name' as a substring search (default false)

tools.name: get_action
tools.title: Get action
tools.description: Looks up an action (ability/spell) by id or name: name, description, level, job, cast and recast times, range, and cost. The description lives on the companion ActionTransient sheet, so it is fetched separately and may be absent.

tools.name: get_status
tools.title: Get status
tools.description: Looks up a status (buff/debuff) by id or name: name, description, max stacks, and the flags that control dispelling and movement locks.

tools.name: get_territory
tools.title: Get territory
tools.description: Looks up a zone/territory by id or name: name, region, zone, map, whether it is a PvP zone, and whether mounts are allowed.

tools.name: get_class_job
tools.title: Get class/job
tools.description: Class and job definitions. Omit classJobId to list every class and job with its abbreviation, which is the cheapest way to map a job id to a name.

tools.name: read_memory
tools.title: Read memory
tools.description: Reads raw process memory at an absolute address. Use format=hexdump for a classic hex+ASCII view of a struct, or a scalar format (u8/u16/u32/u64/i8..i64/f32/f64/pointer/bool/string/utf16) to decode one value. Addresses are validated against the OS region map before reading, so an unmapped or no-access address returns an error rather than crashing the game. Pass the address as a hex string such as "0x7FF6A1B2C3D4" to avoid JSON number precision loss.

length.description: Bytes to read. Defaults to 256 for hexdump, 1024 for string, else the format's size.

format.description: How to decode the bytes (default hexdump)

tools.name: query_memory_region
tools.title: Query memory region
tools.description: Describes what the OS reports for one or more addresses: whether the page is committed, readable, writable, executable, its protection flags, and which allocation region it belongs to. Use this to understand a struct layout before reading it, or to find out why a read failed.

length.description: Also report every region spanning this many bytes from the address

tools.name: read_pointer_chain
tools.title: Read pointer chain
tools.description: Follows a multi-level pointer: dereferences a pointer at the base address, adds the first offset, dereferences again, and so on, then optionally reads a value at the final address. This is the standard way to reach a single field from a static base. Returns every intermediate address so a broken step is obvious.

address.description: Base address to start from, e.g. "0x7FF6A1B2C3D4"

offsets.description: Offsets applied after each dereference, one per level. JSON has no hex literals, so pass hex as a string: [16, 448] and ["0x10", "0x1C0"] both work.

valueFormat.description: Optional: also decode a value at the final address (same names as read_memory)

tools.name: get_module_info
tools.title: Get module info
tools.description: The game module's load address and its .text / .data / .rdata section bases and sizes. Combine a section base with an offset to get an absolute address for read_memory. Every address is returned as a hex string.

tools.name: scan_signature
tools.title: Scan signature
tools.description: Scans the game's code or data for a byte pattern with wildcards, using Dalamud's signature scanner. Patterns look like "48 8B 05 ?? ?? ?? ?? 48 85 C0" where ?? matches any byte. Use this to locate a function or global that has no stable offset, then read_memory the address it returns.

maxResults.description: Maximum matches to return (default 1, 0 means up to 4096; maximum 4096). Single text scans retain SDK E8/E9 resolution; other scans return raw match addresses.

tools.name: read_object_memory
tools.title: Read object memory
tools.description: Reads memory at a game object's address plus an offset. Resolve the object by entityId, objectIndex, or localPlayer, then look at a specific field. This is the bridge between the typed object tools and raw memory: get_game_objects reports an object's address, and this reads the bytes behind it.

localPlayer.description: Read from the local player's object address

address.description: Read from this absolute object address instead of resolving one

offset.description: Byte offset from the object's base address (default 0)

format.description: How to decode the bytes (default hexdump)

tools.name: get_job_gauge
tools.title: Get job gauge
tools.description: Reads the current job gauge straight out of FFXIVClientStructs' JobGaugeManager: the job's ClassJobId and every field of that job's gauge struct, including named bit fields. This is the only gauge surface the plugin has - Dalamud's managed job-gauge accessor is not one of the services it is given. Reports available=false with a reason when the client is not running or its signatures have not resolved.

tools.name: get_active_statuses
tools.title: Get active statuses
tools.description: Reads a character's StatusManager directly out of FFXIVClientStructs: the status array (id, parameter, remaining time, source) plus the header fields Dalamud's managed status list does not expose - the manager's owner, its flag byte, and the special-status timer. Names come from the Status sheet. Identify the character with address, entityId, objectIndex, or localPlayer.

address.description: Raw address of the object as a hex string, e.g. "0x7FF6A1B2C3D4"

entityId.description: Entity id of an object in the object table

localPlayer.description: Read the local player's statuses (equivalent to entityId of the local player)

max.description: Maximum statuses to return (default 60, which is the full array)

tools.name: open_addon
tools.title: Open an addon (UI window)
tools.description: Opens one of the game's addon (UI window) surfaces the way its own keyboard shortcut would: through the FFXIVClientStructs agent layer (AgentInterface.Show). Bounded to an allowlist of standalone-openable system windows; anything that must be opened from a parent context is refused by design. Inventory uses UIModule.OpenInventory and reports its actual immediate open state; other agents still report dispatch only. This is a mutating tool: it is hidden from tools/list and refused by tools/call while the plugin's allow-mutating-tools switch is off.

addon.description: Which addon to open.

tools.name: close_addon
tools.title: Close an addon (UI window)
tools.description: Closes one of the game's addon (UI window) surfaces through the agent layer (AgentInterface.Hide), the same path the game's own close action takes. Accepts the same allowlist names as open_addon. Inventory uses UIModule.CloseInventory and reads back actual state. This is a mutating tool: it is hidden from tools/list and refused by tools/call while the plugin's allow-mutating-tools switch is off.

addon.description: Which addon to close.

tools.name: get_addon_state
tools.title: Get addon (UI window) state
tools.description: Reports which of the allowlisted addon surfaces the agent layer currently considers active, keyed by the same names open_addon accepts. Inventory uses the actual UIModule bag-window state because its persistent agent can remain active with no bag window. Unknown inventory state is listed in unknown, never silently treated as inactive. Read-only.

tools.name: list_loaded_addons
tools.title: Discover loaded native UI windows
tools.description: Lists exact internal names and ids from the native loaded-addon list, including minigames outside the open_addon allowlist. Read-only; use returned names with list_addon_elements or get_addon_node_snapshot. Bounded to the native list capacity.

tools.name: list_addon_elements
tools.title: List addon (UI window) elements
tools.description: Read nodes in any loaded native addon; discover exact names with list_loaded_addons. For UI text use read_addon_text; use this tool when controls, labels, visibility or geometry are needed. For ordinary lookup use label/componentType filters and detail=compact. Copy nodeId and componentPath to click_addon_element or get_addon_node_snapshot; IDs alone can repeat. Filters run before the result limit. truncated/scanIncomplete mean absence or uniqueness cannot be established. visible includes addon, parent and component-scope visibility; full detail also reports selfVisible. Unreadable/cyclic ancestry returns visible=null and scanIncomplete=true. visibleOnly skips known-hidden component subtrees; root ULD arrays support up to4096 entries within the same4096-node total scan budget. Full detail and unfiltered behavior remain the default. Read-only.

addon.description: Exact loaded addon name from list_loaded_addons; not restricted by open_addon.

label.description: Trimmed case-insensitive exact label, up to 256 characters.

containsMatch.description: Use label substring matching (default false); returns all matches, never auto-selects.

componentType.description: Filter by native widget kind, e.g. Button or CheckBox.

visibleOnly.description: Only effectively visible nodes, including addon, ancestors and owning components (default false). Unknown visibility is excluded.

detail.description: compact omits geometry/type/depth; full preserves diagnostic fields (default full).

tools.name: read_addon_text
tools.title: Read text from an addon (UI window)
tools.description: Preferred read-only text path for native UI. Reads visible Text/Button/List labels from the addon node tree and string-valued AtkValue entries in one bounded result. Use this to read native UI text. This does not OCR textured text. visibleOnly defaults true. Node text keeps nodeId/componentPath for follow-up; values keep their AtkValue index. truncated or scanIncomplete means text coverage is incomplete.

addon.description: Exact loaded addon name from list_loaded_addons; not restricted by open_addon.

contains.description: Optional case-insensitive literal text filter, up to 256 characters; returns all matches.

visibleOnly.description: Only effectively visible UI text and skip AtkValue text from a hidden addon (default true).

includeNodeText.description: Read Text/Button/List labels from the addon node tree (default true).

maxTextLength.description: Maximum characters retained per text item, 32-4096 (default 512).

annotations.title: Read text from an addon (UI window)

tools.name: set_addon_checkbox
tools.title: Set a native addon checkbox
tools.description: Reads a guarded native CheckBox and sets its checked state using the installed SDK, then sends its registered addon ButtonClick notification once. Idempotent: unchanged state sends no input. Only visible, enabled controls with matching ownership and an unambiguous addon listener are accepted. dryRun reports current state without input; expectedChecked optionally guards the observed prior state. Does not accept dialogs or press confirmation buttons.

addon.description: Exact loaded addon name.

nodeId.description: Top-level CheckBox node id from list_addon_elements.

checked.description: Desired native checked state; must be a JSON boolean.

componentId.description: Optional top-level component; scope nodeId to its ULD array.

expectedChecked.description: Optional guard: refuse if the current state differs.

dryRun.description: Report the control and current state without changing it.

tools.name: set_addon_text_input
tools.title: Set a native addon text input
tools.description: Replaces text in one visible, enabled native TextInput using the installed SDK SetText path, which applies the control's input limits/formatting. Not Dear ImGui. Discover nodeId/componentPath with list_addon_elements. Plain text only, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; empty clears. dryRun reads without editing. Optional expectedText and expectedAddonId guard prior state. Returns the actual evaluated text and exactMatch because native filtering/truncation can change it. Does not press Enter, submit chat, activate a search button or synthesize an addon callback. Verify resulting UI separately.

addon.description: Exact loaded native addon name.

text.description: Plain text, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes. Empty clears; controls and invalid Unicode are refused.

componentPath.description: Exact component path, outermost first (0-40 ids). Empty/omitted means top-level only.

expectedText.description: Optional exact guard on current evaluated text.

expectedAddonId.description: Optional loaded addon id guard; re-discover after replacement.

dryRun.description: Read current text and report the intended edit without applying it.

annotations.title: Set a native addon text input

tools.name: get_inventory_context
tools.title: Read the open inventory item's context
tools.description: Reads the live inventory context agent's owning addon, container, slot and item identity only while its ContextMenu is visibly open. Validates the target InventoryItem against the context's container/slot. Unknown/dummy/unreadable targets remain unavailable. No menu selection or item operation. Match the returned container/slot with get_inventory before selecting an entry; nativeItemId/nativeFlags are the raw SDK fields, not Dalamud's quality-encoded item id.

annotations.title: Read the open inventory item's context

tools.name: open_addon_context_menu
tools.title: Request a native DragDrop context menu
tools.description: Sends one right-button DragDropClick through the loaded addon's uniquely registered event, using the installed SDK drag/drop event-data layout. Only visible, enabled DragDrop controls owned by the resolved node in an allowlisted ordinary carried-bag grid are supported. Discover nodeId/componentPath first. No drag, item use, left click, menu entry selection or callback guessing. dryRun validates and reports the event without input. requested/dispatched do not prove a menu appeared: inspect ContextMenu and its actual item afterward.

addon.description: Exact loaded ordinary carried-bag grid name; see enum.

nodeId.description: DragDrop component node id from list_addon_elements.

componentPath.description: Exact component scope, outermost first (0-40 ids); omitted/empty is top-level.

expectedAddonId.description: Optional guard on the observed loaded-addon id.

dryRun.description: Validate the native control/event without sending input.

annotations.title: Request a native DragDrop context menu

tools.name: set_addon_numeric_input
tools.title: Set one native numeric input
tools.description: Sets a visible, enabled native NumericInput through the installed SDK SetValue path. Reads the control's current value and live Min/Max, refuses out-of-range values, and returns actual readback. Discover nodeId/componentPath first; dryRun previews without editing. expectedValue/expectedAddonId optionally guard observed state. Identical values send no edit. Does not press Enter, confirm a quantity dialog, select a menu entry or synthesize an addon callback. Inspect resulting UI separately.

addon.description: Exact loaded native addon name.

value.description: Desired signed 32-bit integer within the control's current Min/Max.

componentPath.description: Exact component scope, outermost first (0-40 ids); empty/omitted is top-level.

expectedValue.description: Optional exact guard on the current native value.

expectedAddonId.description: Optional guard on the observed loaded-addon id.

dryRun.description: Read current value/limits and validate the proposed value without editing.

tools.name: get_map_state
tools.title: Read current and selected map state
tools.description: Reads the map agent's current/selected map and territory ids, size factors, offsets, title, and a bounded page of static map markers (icon ids, data keys, native coordinates and optional subtext). Coordinates are raw MapMarkerBase.X/Y, NOT world coordinates or player map coordinates; do not pass them to movement tools. This is not a complete inventory of quests, dynamic objects, flags or temporary markers. Hidden-map selection is cached state; inspect mapVisible/mapReady. No map opening, marker clicking, travel or input.

markerOffset.description: First native static-marker array index (default 0, 0-132). Re-read selectedMapId between pages.

annotations.title: Read current and selected map state

tools.name: get_addon_dropdown
tools.title: Read a native dropdown's options
tools.description: Reads an exactly scoped DropDownList's selected index, open/pending state and a bounded page of indexed labels. Supports at most 1024 options, including closed lists. Unknown labels remain null and scanIncomplete=true. No input or native function invocation. Recheck current options and identity before selecting.

addon.description: Exact visible, ready native addon name.

componentPath.description: Exact outer component scope, outermost first (0-40 ids).

expectedAddonId.description: Optional guard on loaded addon identity.

tools.name: set_addon_dropdown_open
tools.title: Open or close an observed native dropdown
tools.description: Sets the owned dropdown checkbox and sends one uniquely registered ButtonClick to the owning dropdown component. No option selection. Guard with expectedOpen/expectedAddonId; dryRun validates without input. Pending transitions are refused. Re-query isOpen/pending and visible list before selecting an option.

addon.description: Exact visible, ready native addon name.

componentPath.description: Exact outer component scope, outermost first (0-40 ids).

expectedAddonId.description: Optional guard on loaded addon identity.

annotations.title: Open or close an observed native dropdown

tools.name: select_addon_dropdown_item
tools.title: Select an observed native dropdown option
tools.description: Requires an open dropdown: select one indexed option through SDK SelectItem, then send one SDK list-item event to its uniquely registered owning dropdown. Requires an exact expectedLabel and optionally expectedIndex/expectedAddonId. Refuses disabled items, pending UI changes and invalid ownership. dryRun validates without selecting; identical selections send no input. Native selection readback does not prove surrounding addon behavior: verify the actual resulting map/settings/UI separately. No guessed callbacks.

addon.description: Exact visible, ready native addon name.

componentPath.description: Exact outer component scope, outermost first (0-40 ids).

expectedAddonId.description: Optional guard on loaded addon identity.

expectedLabel.description: Required exact current label at index, from get_addon_dropdown.

annotations.title: Select an observed native dropdown option

tools.name: get_addon_list_row
tools.title: Read an observed native list row
tools.description: Reads one observed ListItemRenderer's actual ListItemIndex, owning List/TreeList, selection, visibility and up to 16 direct text nodes. Discover the text and component path with list_addon_elements first. Renderer node IDs and AtkValue indices are NOT row indices. Read-only; no native calls. Only direct List/TreeList-owned renderers are supported.

addon.description: Exact visible ready addon name.

nodeId.description: Observed ListItemRenderer node id, not its text child or list node.

componentPath.description: Exact scope ending in the renderer's owning List/TreeList node.

annotations.title: Read an observed native list row

tools.name: activate_addon_list_row
tools.title: Activate an observed native list row
tools.description: Selects the renderer's actual row index using the SDK list vtable, then emits one SDK ListItemClick to its uniquely registered owning addon. Requires exact expectedIndex and unique expectedText; rejects hidden/disabled/recycled renderers, pending layout, foreign listeners and unresolved SDK methods. dryRun validates without selecting. Activation may trigger travel or other addon actions, including when already selected: it is not idempotent. inputDispatched is not proof of the business outcome; inspect resulting addon/client state. No callback guessing.

addon.description: Exact visible ready addon name.

nodeId.description: Observed ListItemRenderer node id, not its text child or list node.

componentPath.description: Exact scope ending in the renderer's owning List/TreeList node.

expectedText.description: Exact unique direct text from get_addon_list_row.

annotations.title: Activate an observed native list row

tools.name: click_addon_element
tools.title: Click an addon (UI window) element
tools.description: Dispatches one UI event (default: left click) at a node through the loaded addon's own vtable. Discover the actual event type and node first; component-owned controls may require typed tools. Automatic discovery preserves exact registered parameter zero and refuses conflicting exact parameters. Legacy fallback remains only when the requested event type is absent. For list components you may pass 'index' to click a list item directly. CheckBox controls require set_addon_checkbox with an explicit checked state. This is a mutating tool: it is hidden from tools/list and refused by tools/call while the plugin's allow-mutating-tools switch is off.

addon.description: Addon name to click inside (same names open_addon accepts)

addonId.description: Raw AtkUnitBase id of the addon to click inside (overrides addon)

componentId.description: Optional top-level component node id. Resolve nodeId only inside this component, avoiding duplicate child ids elsewhere in the addon.

componentPath.description: Exact component path from list_addon_elements, outermost first (0-40 ids). Empty means top-level only. Do not combine with componentId; ambiguous paths are refused. Re-query after addon replacement.

index.description: For list components: the item index to click instead of a nodeId

event.description: Which discovered event to dispatch: click (default), doubleClick, buttonClick, buttonPress, buttonRelease. Advanced 'registered' sends every registered handler; inspect all effects first.

param.description: Override the event callback param (uint32). Advanced: the game normally derives it from the node's registered handler; ClickLib-style close buttons need 0xFFFFFFFF (-1)

tools.name: get_addon_strings
tools.title: Read an addon (UI window)'s value table
tools.description: Reports the string and scalar values an addon currently carries in its AtkValue table — the text a menu, dialog or list is displaying right now. Use read_addon_text for a concise combined node/AtkValue text view. Each entry is index, type and decoded value; control characters are escaped so the raw payload is visible. Pass 'addon' or 'addonId'. Read-only.

addon.description: Addon name to read (same names open_addon accepts)

addonId.description: Raw AtkUnitBase id to read (overrides addon)

annotations.title: Read an addon (UI window)'s value table

tools.name: select_addon_menu_item
tools.title: Select an item in an addon (UI window) menu
tools.description: Selects a menu entry by normalized label or index. SelectString reads its guarded native popup entries and sends ListItemClick through the list; index is the zero-based menu ordinal, NOT the label's AtkValue index. Use dryRun to inspect indexKind and the selected entry. Other addons retain legacy AtkValue-index callback behavior and require a known callback contract. Ambiguous labels are refused even with containsMatch. A dispatched input is not proof of transition. This is a mutating tool: it is hidden from tools/list and refused by tools/call while the plugin's allow-mutating-tools switch is off.

addon.description: Addon name whose menu to select from

label.description: Menu entry label to select (required unless index is given)

index.description: SelectString: zero-based menu ordinal; other addons: legacy AtkValue index

containsMatch.description: Match labels by substring instead of exact (default false)

dryRun.description: Report the entry that would be selected without activating it

annotations.title: Select an item in an addon (UI window) menu

tools.name: probe_receive_event_enable
tools.title: Hook one addon's ReceiveEvent (diagnostic)
tools.description: Temporary diagnostic: swaps the ReceiveEvent vtable slot of one loaded addon so every UI event it receives (real mouse clicks and synthetic dispatches alike) is captured before being forwarded. Pass 'addon' (any loaded addon name) or 'addonId'. Use probe_receive_event_dump to read captures. Mutating.

addon.description: Addon name to hook (raw loaded addon name, e.g. Currency)

addonId.description: Raw AtkUnitBase id of the addon to hook (overrides addon)

tools.name: probe_receive_event_disable
tools.title: Unhook the ReceiveEvent probe (diagnostic)
tools.description: Restores the ReceiveEvent vtable slot captured by probe_receive_event_enable. Mutating.

tools.name: probe_receive_event_enable_listener
tools.title: Hook one node's registered listener ReceiveEvent (diagnostic)
tools.description: Resolves the addon and node, then hooks the node's FIRST registered listener's ReceiveEvent vtable slot. Real component clicks land on node-registered listeners rather than the addon's own slot, so this captures what a real click delivers. Pass 'addon' (raw loaded addon name) or 'addonId', plus 'nodeId'. Use probe_receive_event_dump to read captures. Mutating.

addon.description: Addon name to hook (raw loaded addon name, e.g. Currency)

addonId.description: Raw AtkUnitBase id of the addon to hook (overrides addon)

nodeId.description: Node whose first registered listener should be hooked

annotations.title: Hook one node's registered listener ReceiveEvent (diagnostic)

tools.name: probe_receive_event_dump
tools.title: Dump captured ReceiveEvent calls (diagnostic)
tools.description: Returns every ReceiveEvent invocation captured since the hook was enabled: event type, param, and the raw event / event-data buffers decoded at their FCS offsets. Read-only.

tools.name: probe_callback_enable
tools.title: Hook the global FireCallback (diagnostic)
tools.description: Temporary diagnostic: installs a global hook on AtkUnitBase.FireCallback so every addon callback the game performs is recorded with its decoded AtkValue[] arguments — the same data SimpleTweaks' Addon Logging → Callbacks shows. Real UI interactions (button clicks, list picks) funnel into these callbacks, so the capture tells an agent exactly which (addon, values) payload reproduces an action. Use probe_callback_dump to read captures. Mutating.

tools.name: probe_callback_disable
tools.title: Unhook the FireCallback probe (diagnostic)
tools.description: Removes the global FireCallback hook installed by probe_callback_enable. Mutating.

tools.name: probe_callback_dump
tools.title: Dump captured FireCallback calls (diagnostic)
tools.description: Returns every addon callback captured since probe_callback_enable: addon name, value count, each AtkValue decoded by type (Int/UInt/Bool/String/...), the close/update-visibility flag, and the return value. Read-only.

tools.name: get_addon_native_dispatch
tools.title: Inspect original addon dispatch addresses
tools.description: Reads current and original ReceiveEvent addresses for one loaded addon. Dalamud can replace entries with managed lifecycle thunks, which are not game executable RVAs. Uses bounded shape-checked reflection over the installed lifecycle registry and guarded pointer reads. No hooks, native calls or memory writes. Unsupported SDK layouts return unavailable.

addon.description: Exact internal name from list_loaded_addons

tools.name: get_addon_node_snapshot
tools.title: Read precise addon node state
tools.description: Reads local and screen geometry, native transform matrices, origins, parent ids, effective visibility, node addresses, animation timelines and the addon's scalar values together on the framework thread. Image nodes also report a guarded selected atlas part/UV rectangle and typed asset metadata; partId/assetId are local identifiers, not text or global icon IDs. visible includes addon/parent/component scopes; selfVisible is the node's own flag. Unreadable or cyclic ancestry reports visible=null. No input or memory writes.

addon.description: Exact internal name of a loaded addon, e.g. Hummer.

componentId.description: Optional top-level component node id; scopes nodeIds to that component's UldManager.

componentPath.description: Exact component path from list_addon_elements, outermost first (0-40 ids). Empty means top-level. Do not combine with componentId.

nodeIds.description: Top-level UldManager node ids (1-32 unique ids). Component children are deliberately excluded to avoid ambiguous ids.

tools.name: sample_addon_nodes
tools.title: Sample addon nodes over consecutive frames
tools.description: Collects frame-aligned snapshots without blocking the game. One sampler at a time, 600 frames maximum, 20 second timeout. Stops if the addon closes or changes identity; unload cancels and removes the listener.

addon.description: Exact internal name of a loaded addon, e.g. Hummer.

componentId.description: Optional top-level component node id; scopes nodeIds to that component's UldManager.

componentPath.description: Exact component path from list_addon_elements, outermost first (0-40 ids). Empty means top-level. Do not combine with componentId.

nodeIds.description: Top-level UldManager node ids (1-32 unique ids). Component children are deliberately excluded to avoid ambiguous ids.

annotations.title: Sample addon nodes over consecutive frames

tools.name: click_addon_when_node_matches
tools.title: Click once when a node reaches a width range
tools.description: Observes each framework frame and dispatches one UI event on a width range, transformed node alignment, or local rotation range. Default right-edge/center matching preserves gauge behavior; matchAxis x/y compares configurable node anchors for moving controls. Position matching rejects rotated/reflected geometry; rotation matching uses explicit local radians without wraparound. The clicked control must be visible and enabled. Integer addon-value guards are checked in the same frame. Bounded to 600 frames / 20 seconds; replacement and disabling mutating tools cancel the request. This tool does not press-and-hold: callers starting movement must handle timeout/stop themselves.

addon.description: Exact internal addon name.

observeNodeId.description: Top-level node whose width is observed.

clickNodeId.description: Top-level visible and enabled node to click once.

componentPath.description: Optional exact component path from list_addon_elements (0-40 ids); applies to every observed/clicked node.

minWidth.description: Inclusive minimum width, 0-65535; required without targetNodeId.

maxWidth.description: Inclusive maximum width, 0-65535; required without targetNodeId.

targetNodeId.description: Optional top-level target marker. Match the observed right edge against its transformed horizontal center.

targetFraction.description: Central fraction of the marker width to accept, greater than 0 and at most 1 (default 0.5). Scales with UI zoom.

matchAxis.description: Match rightEdge (default), x, y, or rotation. x/y requires targetNodeId; rotation uses local radians and minRotation/maxRotation instead of width/target matching.

minRotation.description: For rotation: inclusive minimum local angle in radians, -pi to pi. No wraparound.

maxRotation.description: For rotation: inclusive maximum local angle in radians, -pi to pi. No wraparound.

observeAnchor.description: For x/y: fraction along observed node, 0-1 (default 0).

targetAnchor.description: For x/y: fraction along target node, 0-1 (default 0).

guardValueIndex.description: Optional integer AtkValue index, 0-31; requires guardValue or guardValues.

guardValue.description: Expected integer AtkValue at guardValueIndex; input is sent only while it matches.

guardValues.description: Alternative to guardValue: 1-16 accepted integer values at guardValueIndex.

event.description: UI event name accepted by click_addon_element (default buttonPress).

annotations.title: Click once when a node reaches a width range

tools.name: fire_addon_callback
tools.title: Fire an addon callback with a crafted payload
tools.description: Fires the addon's own callback virtual (AtkUnitBase.FireCallback) with an explicit AtkValue payload, the same call the native UI makes when a player activates a widget. Use this only when no click path exists: unlike click_addon_element it can express semantic callbacks such as "unselect" or "join" that the addon dispatches on the callback number rather than on the clicked node.

addon.description: Name of the loaded addon, for example ContentsFinder.

addonId.description: Raw addon id, used instead of addon when the name is ambiguous.

values.description: Callback payload. Almost every addon treats values[0] as the callback number and the rest as parameters. Values are written as 32 bit integers unless types says otherwise. Defaults to an empty payload.

types.description: Optional per value type override, same length as values. Each entry is one of int, uint, bool, float, string. Defaults to int for every value.

strings.description: Optional per value string override, same length as values. When a value's type is string the matching entry here is used as its contents. Defaults to the empty string.

close.description: Pass true to let the addon close itself after handling the callback. Defaults to false.

annotations.title: Fire an addon callback with a crafted payload

tools.name: get_contents_finder_state
tools.title: Read duty finder state
tools.description: Reads the duty finder agent, the queue state and the game's current content finder condition id. Useful for checking whether a duty selection or a queue actually took effect before acting on it.

tools.name: open_duty_finder_duty
tools.title: Open a duty in the duty finder
tools.description: Selects a duty with the duty finder agent (AgentContentsFinder.OpenRegularDuty) exactly as the native list does when a player picks an entry, optionally toggling unrestricted party first. This is the reliable way to reach a duty without depending on list row coordinates. The selection is asynchronous; poll get_contents_finder_state until the selection or the content finder condition id updates.

cfc.description: ContentFinderCondition row id of the duty to select, for example 290.

unrestricted.description: Set the unrestricted party (undersized) flag before selecting. Omit to leave it untouched.

hideIfShown.description: Pass true to hide the duty finder window if it is already open. Defaults to false.

annotations.title: Open a duty in the duty finder

tools.name: get_duty_list
tools.title: Read the duty finder duty list
tools.description: Walks the duty finder's duty list component (AddonContentsFinder.DutyList) and reports every entry the native list is holding: the category headers, their nested duties, the selected row index and the callback that would toggle the selected group open. Use this to drive the list by index instead of by screen coordinate.

addon.description: Name of the loaded duty finder addon. Defaults to ContentsFinder.

addonId.description: Raw addon id of the duty finder window, used when the name is ambiguous.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of list entries to return. Defaults to 200, capped at 2000.

includeNames.description: Read each entry's own row text. Defaults to true; set false for a cheap index and group overview.

annotations.title: Read the duty finder duty list

tools.name: select_duty_list_group
tools.title: Toggle the selected duty list group
tools.description: Replicates AutoDuty's SelectDuty: while the duty finder's selected row is empty, it fires the list's callback 3 with the number of section headers above the selected row plus one, which expands that group so its duties become selectable. Use it when open_duty_finder_duty has already selected a duty but the join callback is still refused.

addon.description: Name of the loaded duty finder addon. Defaults to ContentsFinder.

addonId.description: Raw addon id of the duty finder window, used when the name is ambiguous.

hideIfShown.description: Open the duty finder first with the given duty if the window is not loaded. Omit to require an already loaded window.

cfc.description: Duty to select through the agent before toggling a group, used together with hideIfShown.

annotations.title: Toggle the selected duty list group

tools.name: imgui_state
tools.title: Read Dear ImGui's input and focus state
tools.description: Reports what Dear ImGui currently believes about the pointer and focus: frame count, display size, mouse position, per-button down state, the WantCaptureMouse / WantCaptureKeyboard / WantTextInput flags, and the hovered / active / nav window and id. This is the ground truth for the imgui_* injection tools: read it before and after a click to see exactly what changed. Read-only, and independent of which plugin owns the window. inputScheduler reports callback readiness, queue depth, owned key leases and last outcome; physicalCursor is the observed OS position. Input tools never warp it.

annotations.title: Read Dear ImGui's input and focus state

tools.name: imgui_windows
tools.title: List Dear ImGui windows
tools.description: Enumerates every Dear ImGui window in the process - Dalamud's, this plugin's, and every other installed plugin's - with its name, id, position, size, and its active / hidden / collapsed / focused flags. Coordinates are in the same space imgui_mouse_click accepts. Filter with 'contains' to match a name fragment. Read-only: it lists windows, it does not need to know who created them.

contains.description: Only report windows whose name contains this text (case-insensitive)

onlyActive.description: Only report the active window and its focus order (default false)

onlyVisible.description: Skip windows that are hidden or have SkipItems set (default false)

tools.name: imgui_mouse_move
tools.title: Move the ImGui pointer
tools.description: Injects a pointer position into Dear ImGui and lets it settle for the requested number of frames, then reports what is hovered. Use this to aim before clicking, or with imgui_state to probe what sits at a coordinate. Use the coordinate space reported by imgui_windows. The OS cursor is never moved; human input cancels the job. Mutating: it synthesises input.

settleFrames.description: Frames to hold the position before sampling (default 2)

moveCursor.description: Legacy option; true is refused. System cursor movement is unsupported (default false)

restoreCursor.description: Legacy option, accepted but ignored; the system cursor is never moved

tools.name: imgui_mouse_click
tools.title: Click with the ImGui pointer
tools.description: Injects a real press-and-release into Dear ImGui at a coordinate - optionally moving there first. The down and up are delivered on separate frames, so the click is not collapsed by ImGui's trickle queue. Reports the hovered window and id captured just before the press, and a full state snapshot afterwards, so the caller can see what was hit and what changed. Works on any ImGui window regardless of which plugin owns it. The OS cursor is never moved; human input cancels the job. Mutating: it synthesises input.

x.description: X in ImGui coordinates (omit to click where the pointer already is)

y.description: Y in ImGui coordinates (omit to click where the pointer already is)

double.description: Also send a second press/release pair (default false)

settleFrames.description: Frames to hold the position before pressing (default 3)

moveCursor.description: Legacy option; true is refused. System cursor movement is unsupported (default false)

restoreCursor.description: Legacy option, accepted but ignored; the system cursor is never moved

expectedWindow.description: Exact observed ImGui window name; refuse if the target changes

expectedId.description: Observed hovered ID for mouse input, or active ID for keyboard/text

tools.name: imgui_mouse_scroll
tools.title: Scroll with the ImGui pointer
tools.description: Injects a mouse wheel event into Dear ImGui, optionally moving the pointer to the widget to scroll first. Deltas are in ImGui wheel units (one notch is 1.0, the same value a real wheel reports). Mutating: it synthesises input.

x.description: X in ImGui coordinates to scroll at (omit to scroll in place)

y.description: Y in ImGui coordinates to scroll at (omit to scroll in place)

settleFrames.description: Frames to hold the position before scrolling (default 2)

expectedWindow.description: Exact observed ImGui window name; refuse if the target changes

expectedId.description: Observed hovered ID for mouse input, or active ID for keyboard/text

tools.name: imgui_key_press
tools.title: Press a key in Dear ImGui
tools.description: Injects a complete key press into Dear ImGui, with optional Ctrl / Shift / Alt modifiers held across the same frames a real chord would span. The key is named with Dear ImGui's own key names (A, Enter, Escape, Tab, Delete, F1, LeftArrow, ...). Any ImGui window in the process sees this exactly as it would see the physical key. User activity cancels the job. The system cursor is never moved. Mutating: it synthesises input.

key.description: Dear ImGui key name, e.g. Enter, Escape, A, F1, LeftArrow

ctrl.description: Hold Ctrl for the press (default false)

shift.description: Hold Shift for the press (default false)

alt.description: Hold Alt for the press (default false)

expectedWindow.description: Exact observed ImGui window name; refuse if the target changes

expectedId.description: Observed hovered ID for mouse input, or active ID for keyboard/text

annotations.title: Press a key in Dear ImGui

tools.name: imgui_key
tools.title: Set a raw ImGui key state
tools.description: Injects an owned key down with a bounded lease (holdMs, default 1000, max 2000), or releases an agent-owned key. User activity, cancellation, gate closure or lease expiry releases ownership. The key is named with Dear ImGui's own key names. Send the matching up promptly. Mutating: it synthesises input.

key.description: Dear ImGui key name, e.g. LeftCtrl, A, Enter

down.description: True for key down, false for key up

expectedWindow.description: Exact observed ImGui window name; refuse if the target changes

expectedId.description: Observed hovered ID for mouse input, or active ID for keyboard/text

holdMs.description: Automatic release lease for down=true; never holds indefinitely

annotations.title: Set a raw ImGui key state

tools.name: imgui_text
tools.title: Type text into Dear ImGui
tools.description: Injects a string as character input into Dear ImGui, the same path the OS keyboard uses for text entry, so IME-free text - including CJK - reaches whatever ImGui input field has keyboard focus. Send it after click_focus / a click on the field. Mutating: it synthesises input.

expectedWindow.description: Exact observed ImGui window name; refuse if the target changes

expectedId.description: Observed hovered ID for mouse input, or active ID for keyboard/text

tools.name: imgui_hover_grid
tools.title: Sweep the ImGui pointer over a grid
tools.description: The generic way to discover what is inside an ImGui window without knowing which plugin drew it. Moves the pointer to every cell of a cols x rows grid covering the given rectangle, holding the position one frame and sampling the next, and returns for each cell whether it is inside a window and which id is hovered. A single call reconstructs the hit layout of any window - find the window rectangle with imgui_windows, sweep it, and the cells where the hovered window or id changes are the controls. rows=1 gives a horizontal scan line. Mutating: it synthesises input.

x0.description: Left edge of the rectangle, ImGui coordinates

y0.description: Top edge of the rectangle, ImGui coordinates

x1.description: Right edge of the rectangle, ImGui coordinates

y1.description: Bottom edge of the rectangle, ImGui coordinates

settleFrames.description: Frames to hold each position before sampling (default 1)

annotations.title: Sweep the ImGui pointer over a grid

tools.name: imgui_wait
tools.title: Wait a number of ImGui frames
tools.description: Idles for a number of frames, letting the client redraw and any animation, popup or layout change settle before the next observation. Read-only.

annotations.title: Wait a number of ImGui frames

tools.name: imgui_cancel_input
tools.title: Cancel ImGui input
tools.description: Cancels queued and active ImGui input and releases only agent-owned keys/buttons. Never moves the system cursor. Inspect cleanupConfirmed; a stopped frame loop cannot confirm cleanup until frames resume.

tools.name: press_game_key
tools.title: Press a native game key
tools.description: Posts a bounded keyboard tap only to the verified game window, never to the system input stream. Each repeat has a key-down/key-up cleanup path. Focus loss stops further input. The game window must be foreground unless activateWindow is requested. Refuses while logged out/loading, in the wrong expected territory, when the native keyboard is unavailable, or when the key was already down. Supports exact SeVirtualKey names such as UP, DOWN, LEFT, RIGHT, RETURN, SPACE, ESCAPE, W, A, S, D, KEY_1, NUMPAD1 and F1. Verify the resulting game/UI state before repeating; dispatch is not proof of a business outcome.

key.description: Exact FFXIV SeVirtualKey enum name, case-insensitive; numeric names are refused

expectedTerritoryId.description: Optional guard: refuse unless the current territory has this id

activateWindow.description: Bring the verified game window to the foreground before sending (default false)

dryRun.description: Validate the client, window and native keyboard and read the current key state without sending (default false)

tools.name: hold_game_key
tools.title: Hold a native game key
tools.description: Posts key-down only to the verified game window, holds for 50-2000ms, then posts key-up to that same window. Focus loss ends the hold early. Cleanup never sends system-wide input. Use this for continuous movement or held UI controls that a one-shot KeyState tap cannot exercise. The verified game window must be foreground unless activateWindow is requested. Refuses logged-out/loading clients, wrong expected territory, unavailable native keyboard state, and keys already down. Verify position/UI state afterwards.

key.description: Exact FFXIV SeVirtualKey enum name, case-insensitive

expectedTerritoryId.description: Optional guard: refuse unless the current territory has this id

activateWindow.description: Bring the verified game window to the foreground before holding (default false)

dryRun.description: Validate the client, window and native keyboard and read the current key state without sending (default false)

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.title: Get inventory
tools.description: Items in the four player inventory bags (saddlebag and retainer bags are not included). Each entry: itemId, name, quantity, isHq, slot.

tools.name: get_equipment
tools.title: Get equipment
tools.description: Currently equipped gear with item level, condition/perfection, spiritbond, glamour id and materia count.

tools.name: search_item_holdings
tools.title: Search player item holdings
tools.description: Find an item across carried bags/crystals, equipped gear, all current armoury slots, normal/premium chocobo saddlebags, and visited retainers' seven bags/crystals/equipment. Returns quantities, slot locations and per-container live/cached/unavailable coverage. Unvisited or unloaded storage is unknown, never zero. Read-only passive snapshots once per second; session-only, cleared on logout/reload. Visit each retainer's inventory to populate its snapshot. Does not open UI, access other characters or include market listings/dresser/armoire.

itemId.description: Base item ID; provide exactly one of itemId or name. HQ uses the same base ID.

name.description: Localized item name, exact match by default, 1-128 characters.

isHq.description: Optional HQ/NQ filter; omit to include both.

scopes.description: Storage scopes; default all supported scopes.

includeCached.description: Include session snapshots of unloaded storage (default true); cached values may be stale.

offset.description: Matching slot offset, 0-10000 (default 0). Re-querying is a new observation.

maxResults.description: Location rows per page, 1-200 (default 100); totals always cover all matches.

tools.name: get_buddy_list
tools.title: Get buddy list
tools.description: Companion (chocobo), pet and trust buddies currently following the player, with HP, level and stance where available.

tools.name: get_duty_state
tools.title: Get duty state
tools.description: Whether a duty (dungeon, raid, trial, etc.) is currently running, plus its content finder name when known.

tools.name: execute_action
tools.title: Execute action
tools.description: Casts a job/general action by id, optionally by action name resolved from the Action sheet. Uses the normal UseAction path, so cooldowns, cast times and range checks all apply. Pass dryRun to ask whether the action could be used right now without using it.

actionName.description: Exact action sheet name; resolved to an id

targetObjectId.description: Target game object id (defaults to self)

dryRun.description: Check usability instead of using the action

requiredClassJobId.description: Optional guard: refuse unless the current job has this id

requiredTerritoryId.description: Optional guard: refuse unless the current territory has this id

tools.name: use_duty_action
tools.title: Use duty action
tools.description: Fires one of the two duty actions (the extra buttons a duty grants), addressed as slot 1 or 2.

tools.name: use_general_action
tools.title: Use general action
tools.description: Executes a general action by id (e.g. 2 jump, 4 sprint, 13 auto-run toggle, 23 dismount, 44 accept raise).

tools.name: set_target
tools.title: Set target
tools.description: Targets a game object by id or by name (exact match first, then substring).

tools.name: set_focus_target
tools.title: Set focus target
tools.description: Sets the focus target by id or name; with no arguments the focus target is cleared.

tools.name: interact_with_target
tools.title: Interact with target
tools.description: Interacts with the current target (talk to NPCs, open chests, gather, etc.).

tools.name: dismount
tools.title: Dismount
tools.description: Dismounts the current mount (no-op report when not mounted).

tools.name: cancel_cast
tools.title: Cancel cast
tools.description: Cancels the action currently being cast.

tools.name: accept_raise
tools.title: Accept raise
tools.description: Accepts a pending raise/rescue.

tools.name: toggle_sprint
tools.title: Toggle sprint
tools.description: Toggles the sprint general action.

tools.name: jump
tools.title: Jump
tools.description: Presses the jump general action once.

tools.name: toggle_autorun
tools.title: Toggle auto-run
tools.description: Toggles auto-run on or off.

tools.name: face_target
tools.title: Face target
tools.description: Turns the character to face the current target.

tools.name: get_cooldowns
tools.title: Get cooldowns
tools.description: Lists the current job's abilities with an active recharge, including inherited class and role actions. remainingSeconds is the time until a charge is available (zero if one remains); nextChargeInSeconds and fullRechargeSeconds distinguish the next charge from full recovery. cooldownReady only describes cooldown/charges, not resources, targets or other use conditions. totalRecastSeconds is one charge's recharge interval. Uses effective level; GCD-only actions are omitted. Read-only.

tools.name: get_gearsets
tools.title: List gearsets
tools.description: Lists the character's saved gearsets with gearset id, slot index, name, class/job row id and abbreviation, item level, linked glamour plate and the gearset flags the gearset list shows (missing main hand, missing gear). Marks the set the client currently has active and reports the current class/job, so an agent can pick the id to equip. Scans all 100 slots and checks Exists, including sparse IDs. The active row includes equipmentMatches for item IDs/HQ (null if unavailable). Read-only: it never equips a set.

tools.name: equip_gearset
tools.title: Equip gearset (change job)
tools.description: Equips a saved gearset, which changes the character to that gearset's class/job with its saved gear. Address the set with gearsetId from get_gearsets or by name; an exact (case-insensitive) name wins, a unique substring is accepted, and an ambiguous or unknown name is refused with the candidates listed. Validates the id, calls the client's EquipGearset and waits up to 3000ms for the gearset, job and equipped item IDs (including HQ) to match. Always reapplies the saved set, even if its index is already active; alreadyActive describes the prior index only. Confirmation does not compare materia, dyes or glamour. success=false with equipResultCode means the client refused (in combat, in a cutscene, during a duty or zone transition, or the set's gear is unavailable); equipResultCode 0 with success=false means the request was accepted but the switch was not observed in time.

gearsetId.description: Gearset id from get_gearsets; takes precedence when both are given

name.description: Gearset name; exact match preferred, otherwise a unique case-insensitive substring

tools.name: set_game_window_state
tools.title: Minimize or restore the game window
tools.description: Explicitly minimizes or restores only this game process's main window. Restoring may activate the game. Use only for an authorized window action. Waits up to 1500ms to observe the requested state and reports observed=false if it has not taken effect. Does not change display mode, size, game settings or other applications. Available without a logged-in character.

annotations.title: Minimize or restore the game window

tools.name: teleport_to_aetheryte
tools.title: Teleport to aetheryte
tools.description: Teleports to an unlocked aetheryte by id or by name. Names are matched loosely: case, punctuation, and leading articles are ignored, and a bare zone name matches its main city aetheryte. Costs the same gil the in-game teleport menu would charge.

aetheryteId.description: Aetheryte row id from get_aetherytes (alternative to name)

name.description: Aetheryte or territory name, e.g. 'Limsa Lominsa' or 'Gridania'

territoryId.description: Restrict the name match to one territory

subIndex.description: Estate/apartment sub-index when the destination has several

tools.name: move_to_entity
tools.title: Move to entity
tools.description: Starts auto-movement toward a game object, following a real navigation mesh. Requires the vnavmesh plugin; the destination is snapped to the floor mesh before moving.

gameObjectId.description: Game object id, decimal or 0x-prefixed hex

allowFlight.description: Permit flying where the zone allows it (default: false)

tools.name: move_to_nearby_targetable_object
tools.title: Move to nearby targetable object
tools.description: Finds the closest targetable object whose name contains the given text and starts auto-movement toward it. Requires the vnavmesh plugin.

name.description: Substring of the object name to walk to

includePlayers.description: Also consider player characters as destinations (default: false)

allowFlight.description: Permit flying where the zone allows it (default: false)

tools.name: get_position
tools.title: Get position
tools.description: Cheap read of where the character is: world x/y/z in yalms, rotation, compass bearing and zone. Use this instead of get_local_player when only navigation state matters.

towardGameObjectId.description: Optional game object id (decimal or 0x-prefixed hex) whose distance in yalms is reported too

tools.name: move_to_position
tools.title: Move to position
tools.description: Walks to raw world coordinates, snapping the requested point onto the navigation mesh first. Reports the destination actually used and whether vnavmesh started a path.

allowFlight.description: Allow flying where the zone permits it (default false)

tools.name: stop_movement
tools.title: Stop movement
tools.description: Cancels the active vnavmesh auto-move. Probes the known candidate stop entry points and reports which one existed; when none does it says so instead of claiming the walk ended.

tools.name: send_chat
tools.title: Send chat
tools.description: Sends a chat message through the chat box. Channels: say, yell, shout, party, alliance, fc, tell (requires target), echo. Leading-slash text is refused: use slash_command for commands. Messages over 500 UTF-8 bytes are refused.

target.description: Character name, only used with channel=tell

tools.name: manage_plugin
tools.title: Manage plugin
tools.description: Loads a development plugin with verified state; other actions dispatch legacy chat commands and only confirm dispatch, not completion. action: load (needs filePath), unload (needs pluginName), reload (needs both), all (reload every plugin). Reloading this plugin would sever the MCP session, so it is refused.

filePath.description: Full path to the plugin DLL (load/reload)

tools.name: slash_command
tools.title: Run slash command
tools.description: Runs any game or plugin slash command exactly as if it had been typed into the chat box, e.g. /duty finder, /target, /pcmd move, /vnav moveto. Use send_chat for ordinary chat and this for commands. The leading slash is required.

command.description: The full command line, starting with '/'

tools.name: get_quest_status
tools.title: Get quest status
tools.description: Reports whether one quest is accepted or complete and which sequence step it is on, looked up by quest id or by (partial) name. Searches every installed client language, so a quest can be found by its English name even on a non-English client.

query.description: Quest name, or part of it (alternative to questId)

maxResults.description: How many name matches to report, 1-20 (default 8)

tools.name: get_available_quests
tools.title: Get available quests
tools.description: Lists quests that are currently offered in the world but not yet accepted, with the map marker position, level and objective id. Use nameContains to narrow a busy zone.

nameContains.description: Only report quests whose name contains this text

tools.name: plugin_list
tools.title: List installed plugins
tools.description: Lists the plugins Dalamud reports, with their load state and manifest summary. Use the cursor from the previous page to fetch the next one.

query.description: Optional: only plugins whose name or internal name contains this text

cursor.description: Opaque offset returned by the previous page

tools.name: plugin_describe
tools.title: Describe an installed plugin
tools.description: Reports one plugin's manifest in full: author, description, version, repository, tags and load state.

pluginName.description: Plugin display name or internal name (case-insensitive)

tools.name: list_plugin_repositories
tools.title: List plugin repositories
tools.description: Reads configured third-party repositories and effective runtime repositories, including refresh state, main/preset protection and whether configuration matches runtime. Does not refresh or edit. Follow nextCursor.

tools.name: list_available_plugins
tools.title: Search installable plugins
tools.description: Reads Dalamud's filtered available catalog without refreshing. Returns exact internalName, repositoryUrl, stable/testing versions and installed state for guarded install_plugin calls. A stale/failed repository is not proof a plugin is absent. Follow nextCursor.

tools.name: add_plugin_repository
tools.title: Add a third-party plugin repository
tools.description: Adds one HTTP(S) index URL, enabled by default, saves Dalamud configuration and refreshes repositories. Does not install plugins. Existing entries are refused. Returns an operationId; poll get_plugin_operation until terminal. Refresh failure does not roll back saved settings.

url.description: Exact HTTP(S) plugin index URL, max 2048 characters; no credentials or fragment.

tools.name: remove_plugin_repository
tools.title: Remove a third-party plugin repository
tools.description: Removes one exact configured third-party URL, saves and refreshes repositories. Installed plugins and their configuration are preserved. Main and automatically enabled preset repositories are protected. Poll get_plugin_operation; refresh failure does not roll back saved settings.

tools.name: set_plugin_repository_enabled
tools.title: Enable or disable a third-party repository
tools.description: Sets one exact configured third-party repository's enabled flag, saves and refreshes repositories. Does not load, unload or uninstall its plugins. Main and automatically enabled preset repositories are protected. Poll get_plugin_operation.

annotations.title: Enable or disable a third-party repository

tools.name: refresh_plugin_repositories
tools.title: Refresh plugin repositories
tools.description: Refreshes the current repository configuration through Dalamud. No plugins are installed or updated. Poll get_plugin_operation; inspect per-repository refresh state, because a completed task can contain failed repositories.

tools.name: install_plugin
tools.title: Install one repository plugin
tools.description: Installs and attempts to load one exact internalName/repositoryUrl/version from list_available_plugins through Dalamud. Stable by default; testing requires testing=true. Existing installations, safe mode, the MCP host, stale targets and unavailable sources are refused. Poll get_plugin_operation; installed and loaded are separate results. Never retries an installation automatically.

internalName.description: Exact internal name from list_available_plugins, max 128 characters.

repositoryUrl.description: Exact source index URL from list_available_plugins.

expectedVersion.description: Exact selected stable/testing version from list_available_plugins.

testing.description: Use the testing version, default false.

tools.name: uninstall_plugin
tools.title: Uninstall one installed plugin
tools.description: Unloads one exact internalName/version, schedules its files for Dalamud cleanup and removes it from the installed list. Preserves plugin configuration. No recursive file deletion. Refuses the MCP host, development plugins, ambiguous names and lifecycle transitions. Poll get_plugin_operation; deletionScheduled does not mean filesDeleted.

internalName.description: Exact installed internal name from plugin_list.

tools.name: get_plugin_operation
tools.title: Read a plugin installer operation
tools.description: Reads one operation by operationId, or the newest operation when omitted. status=running/succeeded/failed; terminal is authoritative for this task, not for arbitrary later changes. History is bounded to 20 operations and lost on MCP host reload. No cancellation: an already-started Dalamud task may finish after mutation access is disabled. Do not repeat a nonterminal operation.

operationId.description: Returned operation ID; omitted selects newest.

tools.name: list_plugin_commands
tools.title: Discover registered plugin commands
tools.description: Reads the live Dalamud command registry and registered help without executing handlers. Filter by command/help/handler assembly with query. Handler assembly is a hint, not proof of plugin ownership (shared command frameworks can own wrappers). Hidden-help entries are included. Follow nextCursor.

tools.name: open_plugin_ui
tools.title: Open a loaded plugin's supported UI
tools.description: Requests exactly one loaded plugin's public main/config UI callback through IExposedPlugin. Exact internalName or display name only; ambiguous loaded names and unavailable callbacks are refused. This opens UI only; requested=true does not prove a window appeared or a feature ran. Inspect addon/ImGui state afterward.

pluginName.description: Exact plugin internal or display name.

ui.description: Which supported UI to open (default main).

annotations.title: Open a loaded plugin's supported UI

tools.name: get_tribal_quest_state
tools.title: Read tribal reputation and daily allowance
tools.description: Reads the installed SDK quest manager's remaining tribal allowance, all named BeastTribe sheet rows, guarded reputation work records and daily quest slots. Reports raw rank/value and sheet maximum; unknown ranks remain unknown. Does not accept quests, advance rank or call third-party plugins. Read-only.

annotations.title: Read tribal reputation and daily allowance

tools.name: load_dev_plugin
tools.title: Register and load a local development plugin
tools.description: Registers a local plugin DLL and sibling manifest, loads it through the installed plugin manager, then waits until the loaded assembly's MVID matches the file and remains loaded for 750ms. This prevents returning an old instance during build-triggered hot reload. Times out rather than claiming an obsolete build is ready. Conflicting installed paths and loading the MCP host itself are refused. Uses shape-checked managed reflection because Dalamud has no public loader API.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a local plugin DLL with a sibling JSON manifest.

autoReload.description: Watch the build output for automatic reload (default true).

buildWaitMs.description: Wait for the matching loaded build, 1000-30000ms (default 15000).

annotations.title: Register and load a local development plugin

tools.name: query_push_data
tools.title: Query pushed data
tools.description: Reads payloads other plugins pushed over IPC (newest first). Pass key to filter by tag; each entry has id, key, data (arbitrary JSON) and timestamp.

key.description: Optional: only entries with this tag

tools.name: register_ipc_endpoint
tools.title: Register IPC endpoint
tools.description: Declares that another plugin exposes an IPC method MCP may call. Supported signatures are listed in the signature enum, including bounded single-string queries. Declaring the endpoint does not contact the other plugin; call_plugin_ipc does.

signature.description: The IPC delegate shape the method implements

tools.name: call_plugin_ipc
tools.title: Call plugin IPC
tools.description: Invokes a previously registered endpoint. Signatures Func<bool> and Func<string> take no argument; Func<int, string> expects arguments.value to be an integer; Action<bool> and Func<bool, string> expect arguments.value to be a boolean. Func<string, bool>, Func<string, bool?> and Func<string, string> require a JSON string of at most 4096 characters. All IPC invocation requires AllowMutatingTools because a declared function can also change game/plugin state. Argument coercion is refused.

value.description: Exact JSON argument for single-argument signatures; strings are limited to 4096 characters; omit for zero-argument signatures

tools.name: list_ipc_endpoints
tools.title: List IPC endpoints
tools.description: Lists every endpoint registered through register_ipc_endpoint, optionally filtered by plugin.

pluginName.description: Optional: only endpoints of this plugin

tools.name: plugin_data_subscribe
tools.title: Subscribe to plugin data
tools.description: Retains the payloads a plugin pushes over the push channel under one key, in a dedicated queue that plugin_data_poll drains incrementally. Payloads that arrive while nothing is subscribed are only visible through query_push_data and are lost to the rolling buffer once it wraps.

capacity.description: Retained entries before the oldest are dropped (16-10000, default 1000)

tools.name: plugin_data_poll
tools.title: Poll subscribed plugin data
tools.description: Drains retained payloads for a subscribed key, oldest first. Drained entries are removed, so each payload is delivered once; remaining entries stay for the next poll.

tools.name: plugin_data_unsubscribe
tools.title: Unsubscribe from plugin data
tools.description: Stops retaining payloads for a key and discards anything still queued for it.

tools.name: query_events
tools.title: Query events
tools.description: Returns recently recorded game events (newest first). Event types: hp_change, mp_change, gp_change, player_move, job_change, target_change, focus_target_change, target_hp_change, combat_damage, combat_start, combat_end, map_change, mount_change, duty_update, fate_update, nearby_enemy, nearby_player.

types.description: Optional filter: only these event types

since.description: Only events with timestamp >= this Unix ms time

before.description: Only events with timestamp <= this Unix ms time

tools.name: configure_event_collection
tools.title: Configure event collection
tools.description: Changes what the event collector records. Categories: playerStats[hp,mp,gp,job,position], targetStats[hp,type,targetChange], objectTypes[enemy], combatEvents[damage,startEnd], systemEvents[duty,fate]. objectRange/nearbyPlayerRange 0-200 (0 = off), throttleMs 50-60000.

objectRange.description: Enemy scan radius in yalms (0 disables)

nearbyPlayerRange.description: Player scan radius in yalms (0 disables)

throttleMs.description: Minimum ms between two records of one event type

tools.name: get_event_config
tools.title: Get event config
tools.description: Current event collection configuration and buffer usage.

tools.name: events_wait
tools.title: Wait for events
tools.description: Blocks until a matching event is recorded, or the timeout elapses. Pass afterId from a previous query (its lastId) to wait for something newer. Returns the new events oldest first, plus timedOut=true when nothing arrived in time.

afterId.description: Only events newer than this cursor (default: the newest so far)

types.description: Optional filter: only these event types

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait in milliseconds (1-30000, default 10000)

tools.name: combat_recording_configure
tools.title: Configure combat recording
tools.description: Persistently enable/disable background recording (default on). Entering combat opens an encounter; leaving combat closes and compresses it. Independent of MCP clients/listener. Resumes after login and when the mutation gate reopens. Configuration changes close/archive an active encounter; unchanged continuous settings are idempotent. Server action effects (raw effects, direct damage/heal), sampled casts/statuses/deaths at 100ms. Not an FFLogs parser: no periodic DoT/HoT tick attribution, cast requests, guaranteed cast-end reason, full encounter mechanics, or upload. Effect amounts are server announcements, not confirmed effective HP loss/healing. Actor names are omitted. Completed encounters are compressed automatically; a process crash can lose the active encounter and queued writes.

scope.description: all (default, nearby visible actors), or local (own/pet actions plus effects targeting self); omitted preserves the saved scope

tools.name: combat_recording_status
tools.title: Combat recording status
tools.description: Server action effects (raw effects, direct damage/heal), sampled casts/statuses/deaths at 100ms. Not an FFLogs parser: no periodic DoT/HoT tick attribution, cast requests, guaranteed cast-end reason, full encounter mechanics, or upload. Effect amounts are server announcements, not confirmed effective HP loss/healing. Actor names are omitted. Completed encounters are compressed automatically; a process crash can lose the active encounter and queued writes.

tools.name: combat_recording_list
tools.title: List combat encounters
tools.description: Lists memory encounters oldest first and automatic compressed archives newest first (survive plugin reload). Includes truncation/partial-start metadata for memory encounters.

tools.name: combat_recording_read
tools.title: Read combat timeline
tools.description: Capture order with millisecond timestamps and elapsedMs (pre-pull can be negative). Cursor is event id; no events are drained. Falls back to compressed archives, including after reload. Disk/decompression runs off the game thread.

tools.name: combat_recording_export
tools.title: Export combat encounter
tools.description: Writes one retained encounter as JSON under the plugin config combat-recordings folder. No arbitrary path. Keeps the most recent 10 exports. Includes coverage limitations and raw effects.

tools.name: get_chat_log
tools.title: Get chat log
tools.description: Returns chat lines captured since the plugin loaded, oldest first. Filter by chat type (the XivChatType name, e.g. Say, Party, TellIncoming), sender, or a message substring. Pass afterId from a previous reply to fetch only newer lines; the reply's lastId is the cursor for the next call.

chatType.description: Optional: only this chat type, e.g. Say or Party

sender.description: Optional: only lines whose sender contains this text

contains.description: Optional: only lines whose message contains this text

afterId.description: Optional: only lines with an id greater than this cursor

since.description: Optional: only lines at or after this Unix ms time

before.description: Optional: only lines at or before this Unix ms time

tools.name: get_dalamud_log
tools.title: Get Dalamud runtime log
tools.description: Reads Dalamud and plugin runtime logs captured since this plugin loaded, oldest first. Read-only; works while logged out. Poll with returned streamId and nextAfterId as afterId; do not use lastId as the pagination cursor. Check hasMore and historyLost. Retains 1000 entries; count 1-200 (default 100), response limited to 64000 JSON characters plus metadata. Messages/exceptions are each clipped to 4096 characters. No historical file logs or events suppressed by Dalamud's logging level.

minLevel.description: Verbose, Debug, Information, Warning, Error or Fatal (default Verbose)

source.description: Case-insensitive SourceContext substring, max 256 characters; absent source stays empty

afterId.description: Return entries after this nextAfterId cursor (default 0)

streamId.description: Previous response streamId; detects plugin reload (max 64 characters)
